verdict.rationale: Graphite Chat accepts natural-language requests on the PR page to summarize changes, explain code, diagnose failing CI and apply suggested fixes. Graphite Agents take plain-language descriptions of what to build or fix and open a draft PR. GT MCP also lets external AI agents drive stacked-PR creation. Missing for 10: no evidence of natural-language control over core operations like stack management, merge queue or CLI configuration (the CLI uses explicit gt commands), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the chat/agent workflows.
